name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Titles you own and a friend also holds. Your own file always plays when the device can play it as stored (a friend's copy of a title you own is still never added to the library). New: when a device cannot play your own file as stored, a friend's copy that the same device plays as stored is offered first, straight from the friend, and your own file stays as the copy to convert. A friend's copy of an owned title is never converted, and devices that play your file are not affected at all. Active with "pick the best copy automatically" on, and always on a server that may not convert. Checked with unit tests and two-server container runs; not yet verified on physical TV or phone players.
